description: Email verification: checks whether an email address really exists by asking its mail server (SMTP RCPT TO probe; no email is sent), on top of syntax, MX, disposable and role checks. Returns status deliverable, undeliverable (mailbox does not exist), catch_all (domain accepts any address), risky (disposable or mailbox full) or unknown (greylisting, server refused the check), plus the raw SMTP reply. Use it before sending outreach, to clean lead lists or to block fake sign-ups. Results are cached 6 hours. Params: email (required). Price: $0.005 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"email":"support@github.com"}.
name: email_verify
title: Email Deliverability Verification (SMTP)
